{{Field procedure|summary=Deploy collector limpets efficiently and avoid common mistakes that destroy limpets or slow collection.}}

Use this procedure when fragments, chunks, cargo, or materials are floating near the ship and a [[Collector Limpet Controller]] is fitted.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you start ==

* Fit and power a [[Collector Limpet Controller]].
* Carry limpets in cargo.
* Make sure the cargo hatch can open and the ship has room for what collectors bring back.
* Position the ship so limpets do not have to fly through asteroid surfaces or other obstacles.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Stop targeting individual fragments unless you deliberately want a single-use pickup.
# Open the cargo hatch if it is not already open.
# Launch collector limpets after useful fragments or chunks are available.
# Keep the ship steady and close enough that collectors have a short, clear path.
# Continue extraction while collectors return items to the ship and refinery.
# Watch the refinery and cargo hold so collectors do not waste time on blocked or unwanted fragments.
# Move carefully when repositioning; give active limpets space to follow without hitting rock.
}}

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when useful fragments have been collected and are either processed by the [[Refinery]] or stored as cargo or materials.

== Common problems ==

* '''A collector dies after one pickup:''' the ship probably had a fragment or cargo canister targeted when the limpet launched.
* '''Collectors keep dying:''' move farther from asteroid surfaces and avoid dragging limpets through rock.
* '''Collectors bring unwanted fragments:''' use [[How to Ignore Unwanted Mining Commodities]] and clear unnecessary refinery bins.
* '''Collectors stop working:''' check cargo space, refinery space, cargo hatch status, controller power, and remaining limpets.
